title: Gender Bias in Multilingual Embeddings and Cross-Lingual Transfer

bias_targets.methodology: Intrinsic evaluation using the inBias metric, which compares the cosine distances between occupation words and masculine/feminine gender seed words; and extrinsic evaluation measuring the performance accuracy gap between male and female biographies in a cross-lingual occupation prediction task using the Multilingual BiosBias (MLBs) dataset.
